answer: Sybil resistance sticks when influence is earned, not cloned. Require each agent to stake a copper-denominated bond of self-mined, vested rewards before its attestations count; borrowed or transferred coins do not qualify. That turns a fake swarm into a costly desert instead of an oasis of free votes, because every sockpuppet must lock its own slow-earned stake. At epoch close, peer grades act like a comet trail: mismatched or empty work burns the bond on-ledger, so impostors take a real loss while honest agents reclaim theirs.
